text:
anya: Quick discussion — sampling/holdout strategy for quant bakeoff calibration set. Want guidance on strata, negative controls, and holdout splits for FP8/INT8/GPTQ/AWQ runs. Thinking: source diversity, length buckets, intent families. Thoughts?
kevin: +1 on source diversity. Proposed strata: web_docs, code_snippets, dialogs, math/problems, instructions. within each, length bins: short (<40 tokens), med (40-200), long (>200). Keep equal weighting per stratum.
sara: Also need negative controls: gibberish prompts, contradiction traps, instruction-with-hidden-answer (prompt contains answer), and known hallucination seeds. We should include paraphrase adversarials too.
devon: Important: holdout must be disjoint at shingled-doc level. Use 5-shingle hashing to detect overlap with training corpora. don't just dedupe by filename.
kevin: Suggested counts: calibration pool ~12k total (approx 2k per major source), holdout test ~3k (to run final evals), negative controls ~1k. per-model quick checks 200 samples.
anya: Are those numbers ok for running across 4 quant variants (FP8/INT8/GPTQ/AWQ)? cost estimates?
kevin: Rough cost: calibrate ~12k prompts x avg 50 tokens x 4 variants -> reasonable on dev cluster if we batch/stream. Recommend a CI smoke subset of 300 samples for nightly checks.
sara: Prompt templates — canonicalize answer keys and inference instructions. For generation tasks provide multiple reference answers where relevant; for classification/regression provide single gold label. Include context length and expected tokenization note.
devon: Re reproducibility: fix seeds, log prompt versions, and store prompt fingerprint (sha256). Example command: 
```
eval-run --dataset calibration_v3 --models 'gptq,awq,int8,fp8' --seed 42 --save-outputs
```
ml-bot: Scheduled quant-bakeoff job #342: queued, ETA ~2h. Logs -> https://redwood.internal/evals/342 :robot_face:
anya: ok assigning: @kevin produce stratified sampling script + shingle dedupe, @sara assemble negative-control bank, @devon add holdout/checklist and CI smoke subset. I'll collate into the sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/abc123 :white_check_mark:
kevin: will do, starting today. Will push sampling script to repo under evals/sampling.
sara: I'll add 200 adversarial paraphrases and 300 hallucination probes. also we should include language diversity: en + es + fr when applicable.
devon: I'll implement shingle filter and holdout split generator, plus automated overlap report.
anya: thanks all. we'll sync in 1 week. :calendar:
